job: Finish the local-first land/site flow so a person can state a lot, optionally inspect a user-triggered Edmonton public-register result, commit the stated evidence into the active project, and see it in Guided and Pro builder modes without any fictional listing, feed, confirmed-fit, or professional claim.

inputs.version: City of Edmonton Open Data terms v2.1 plus recorded dataset metadata

outputs.acceptance: No placeholder can be committed as owner-stated; the explicit save control changes the persisted active project; missing-project and incomplete-evidence states fail visibly.
The lookup is user-triggered, discloses its source and limits, never exposes owner names, never claims sale authority or confirmed fit, and never silently overwrites owner-stated dimensions.
Committed site evidence is visible and editable in both Guided and Pro modes; identical values produce the same project state.
All focused land tests, registered UI tests, TypeScript, accessibility checks, and gate-coverage assertions pass from a stable source snapshot.

dependsOn.evidence: Existing AuraProject/project-command and storage gates on origin/main d0fc2f6
Existing builder Site step and project-site contract on origin/main d0fc2f6

rejectionGates: Reject if any landing-scene, builder-model geometry, GLB, meadow, tree, sky, mountain, shader, camera, lighting, or animation file changes.
Reject if demo inventory is on by default or demonstration data can complete a real project stage.
Reject if a public parcel or register row is presented as a ListingOffer, confirmed fit, title evidence, survey, or professional approval.
Reject if an address lookup occurs without an explicit user action, owner names are exposed, or a returned area silently overwrites stated dimensions.
Reject if rendered copy says no register call exists while the page offers a live register request.
Reject if the save control can report success without changing persisted project state.
Reject if either Guided or Pro mode hides the committed site evidence.
Reject if any new test is absent from a declared unit or UI gate.
Reject if work crosses brokerage, provider, legal, property-fund, payment, HOMES, mainnet, DNS, deployment, or outreach gates.

verify.freshContextVerifier: A verifier that did not implement LC01 must inspect the final stable snapshot.
